items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I never knew him. He played with him in the Adolf, a big Brownstein fella, his name was Adolf something, I forget his other name.

ctx.x: Who was in that band then?

The Creole Serenators? They had, the piano player was Newman. Oh yeah. Yeah, you remember Newman. But he died. I never knew him. He played with him in the Adolf, a big Brownstein fella, his name was Adolf something, I forget his other name. He played with him a while.

items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What did the name La Vida come from? Was that the name of the man who owned the place? [INTERVIEWEE] It was a Jew.

ctx.x: I retired June 1st. It was this year. In 33 years.
What did the name La Vida come from? Was that the name of the man who owned the place?
